French students protest nationwide over school conditions and funding

Students across France took to the streets, sparking clashes that involved fires and tear‑gas, leading to school closures and leaving hundreds injured; the demonstrations began in Paris and spread nationwide, with protesters citing a teacher shortage, deteriorating school infrastructure and cuts to the education budget as the main grievances.
